title: Sarasota County School Board, District 1
what_it_does: School board members set the district budget and school-tax rate, hire the superintendent (where appointed), approve school boundaries, curriculum policy and construction, and set district policies. Nonpartisan.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); both candidates are marked Qualified, which for a nonpartisan seat means the August vote did not produce a majority winner (or the seat is decided only in November). Positions have not been researched; check the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Heidi Brandt
candidates.photo_source: Ballotpedia candidate photo (downloaded copy in assets/photos)
candidates.background: Brandt is the president of the parent-teacher council at Southside Elementary School and the parent of an elementary-school student in Sarasota County. She finished second in the August 2026 District 1 primary and advanced to the Nov. 3 runoff. She is endorsed by the Republican Party of Sarasota County.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

education_choice.summary: Brandt says she supports the use of vouchers but calls Florida's system broken, favoring a sliding scale tied to family income rather than full scholarships regardless of income.

sources.title: Three open seats could change the direction of Sarasota County Schools

school_safety.summary: Brandt said she would not have voted for the school board's resolution penalizing student protesters, saying she asked a number of people about it and was told it was pointless, and raising concern that it would be applied unevenly.
school_safety.quote: no, it's pointless. So, no, I wouldn't have voted for that.

sources.title: Three open seats could change the direction of Sarasota County Schools

other_issues.title: Board resolution on immigration enforcement
other_issues.summary: Brandt said she opposed the board's resolution on federal immigration enforcement, saying it drew up a lot of fear and was not necessary.

sources.title: Three open seats could change the direction of Sarasota County Schools

candidates.name: Jimmy Glover
candidates.background: Glover has more than 30 years with United Airlines and chairs the board of Star Lab, a small K-3 school in Sarasota. He is the father of four children educated in Sarasota County public schools and his wife is a former district teacher. He serves as vice chair of the City of Sarasota's Parks, Recreation and Environmental Protection Advisory Board, and led the August 2026 District 1 primary, advancing to the Nov. 3 runoff.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

school_books.summary: Glover says he did not vote for book bans or culture wars and that his family's values were not represented by the current board's direction. He frames his campaign as returning the board's focus to students rather than politics.
school_books.quote: I didn't vote for book bans or culture wars

sources.title: Jimmy Glover for Sarasota County School Board - campaign site

teacher_pay.summary: Glover's platform includes supporting teachers with competitive pay and respect for their expertise. He has not proposed a specific raise or named spending he would cut.
teacher_pay.quote: competitive pay and respect for their expertise

sources.title: Jimmy Glover for Sarasota County School Board - campaign site

school_safety.summary: Glover lists mental health together with school safety as a campaign pillar, and his approach emphasizes mentorship and college and career readiness rather than tougher discipline.
